killedBy: the self-test body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1013) builds the body once: a second visit keeps the same rows
why: Issue #1013. Every open loads and builds the body again instead of only the first. Before the issue the view was built once and kept; a rebuild per open throws away the rows and repaints the empty state over a connected pad. The criterion is that the view is not rebuilt on every open.
